verdict.rationale: gstack ships its own compiled CLI (`$B`) that fronts a persistent headless Chromium daemon, which agents use as the fallback browser. That is a first-party CLI, but it is documented only for browser control. The rest of gstack's workflows (review, QA, ship) are delivered as agent skills in host tools like Claude Code, not as CLI commands. Missing for 10: a general-purpose gstack CLI covering the main workflows, a documented command reference or install/usage docs for `$B`, and independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: gstack falls back, automatically, to the browser it ships itself: a persistent headless Chromium daemon behind a compiled CLI ($B).
a persistent headless Chromium daemon behind a compiled CLI (`$B`)
